outlook.statement: Optimistic about long-term prospects of Indian steel and renewable energy sectors; focus on improving utilisation of expanded billet capacity, optimising manufacturing operations, deriving greater benefits from renewable energy integration, expanding value-added steel production, maintaining disciplined cost and working-capital management, and diversifying customer base.
Initiated the process of replacing the existing coal-based blast furnace with a modern electric furnace.

The 66.25 MWp Solar Power Project has been commissioned and operational since December 2025, enabling the Company to progressively increase its use of renewable energy and reduce dependence on conventional fossil fuels.

Global steel demand expected to remain broadly stable in 2026 with 0.3% growth, stronger growth anticipated in 2027; India steel demand projected to increase 7.4% in 2026 supported by infrastructure spending, construction, automotive demand and capex.

Company remains focused on sustainable growth, capacity utilisation, cost efficiency and value creation; expanded billet capacity, focus on special-grade steel, technology upgradation and renewable power generation provide opportunities to improve capacity utilisation, product mix and cost efficiency.
